parallels.note: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

translations.web: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.
translations.bsb: What then did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.
translations.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.
translations.asv: But wherefore went ye out? to see a prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
